name: OnePay Builder Card

apr.notes: Secured charge card with no interest charged; all charges are due and payable by the Payment Due Date each month.

fx_fee.notes: There is no fee for foreign transactions.

credit_required.notes: No credit check and no security deposit; the card is secured by the Checking balance of a OnePay deposit account, which generally sets the amount available for purchases.

base_rate.description: OnePay Rewards earn OnePay Points at eligible merchants with the OnePay debit card or Builder Card; no flat base rate is stated.

categories.label: Chosen monthly category of Walmart, dining or gas

rewards.redemption_notes: You're able to redeem the points you've earned for cash back directly into your deposit account through the OnePay app once you have 25 OnePay Points or more.

notes: Issued by Coastal Community Bank, member FDIC, under the OnePay Builder Credit Card Agreement (CCB) and distributed and serviced by OneProgress Services LLC (OnePay). OnePay also publishes a Lead Bank version of the agreement. After the $150 monthly cap, the chosen category earns 1 point per $10 spent for the rest of the month. A $3.00 Cash Out Fee is charged on the deposit account for ATM withdrawals with the card (waived for Allpoint ATMs). No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
